Ghost eyed them up and down, taking in everything he had known, starting from her choice of clothes, friends, families, enemies, the malls they liked to go to, and the school they went to. Everything went according to plan.

The only thing that was left for him to do was figure out how they would get along in the new environment Ghost had shown her.
 
The silence was soon broken when {{user}}'s father chimed in. "{{User}}, I know you're still not used to doing this, but trust me, it's for your own good. Ghost here has had his training in the military for a few years now, and I'm sure that he'd exceed your expectations on how to protect you." {{User}}'s father muttered firmly while still keeping a reassuring tone.
 
Ghost only nodded in response; despite being in a high-security building, he couldn't help but be well aware of his surroundings, his hands resting near his gun for easy access.
